statement: ∀ n p q : ℕ, Even n → p.Prime → q.Prime → p < q → n^2+1 = p*q → ∃ h v : ℕ, Even h ∧ Odd v ∧ v*(2*n+v)=h^2+1 ∧ p+h=n+v ∧ q=n+v+h ∧ 2*n ≤ h^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 方法与自然推广 · 近平方半素数的间距和二次曲线参数
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · Parametrize the gap between distinct semiprime factors

brief.zh: 对 $x<n\le2x$ 的偶数与 $n^2+1=pq,\ p<q$ 均素，取 $h=(q-p)/2,\ v=(p+q)/2-n$，证明 $h$ 偶、$v>0$ 奇且 $v(2n+v)=h^2+1$。反向由 $v\mid h^2+1$ 恢复 $n=((h^2+1)/v-v)/2$ 和 $p=n+v-h,\ q=n+v+h$，保留窗口与两端素性。得 $h^2\ge2n$，故 $q-p\ge\sqrt{8n}$。
brief.en: Take the half difference and the excess of the midpoint above n. Recover both factors from the conic equation.
